prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select Your Companion Path", "Pick a ready-made desktop companion or create a custom pet tailored to your workspace.", "Choose path option"]
1: ["Listen to pet sound"]
2: ["Define Your Pet's Personality", "Select traits like energetic, calm, or chatty to customize your desktop pet's behavior.", "Select personality trait", "Continue"]
3: ["Sync & Protect Your Pet Data", "Signing in links your pet companion to your cloud account so your pet state and history are safe even if you switch devices or reinstall.", "Your pet remains safe and synchronized in your account."]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "We are setting up your companion graphics and animations.", "Tips for interacting with your companion while on the desktop."]
5: ["Your Pet is Ready for Your Desktop", "Check display permissions if your pet isn't visible on your main screen.", "Ensure display overlay permissions are granted."]
6: ["How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet", "Click to pet, right-click for settings, or use key shortcuts to hide your companion anytime.", "Got It!"]
7: ["Uploading and Processing Companion Photos", "We are processing your companion images for high-fidelity 3D rendering."]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet World", "Instant Companion Setup"]
9: ["Save Your Adopted Companion", "Sign in to save your new companion's certificate and progress."]
